newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka strives to project positive image.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka strives to project positive image.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Foreign Ministry said on Saturday it was stepping up efforts to project a positive image of the war-torn country to the world.
A ministry statement said the government would appoint communications experts to its missions in key capitals.

"These officers will engage in projecting a positive image of Sri Lanka from their respective stations and endeavour to correct any misperceptions entertained in some quarters in these countries," a ministry statement said.
It said five professionals, mostly journalists, were being appointed to Sri Lankan missions in London, Ottawa, Stockholm, New Delhi and Bangkok.
Sri Lanka has been plagued by negative publicity from fighting between its armed forces and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels.
Officials said the main aim behind the appointments was to counter LTTE propaganda.
The LTTE are fighting a 13-year-old war for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east.
The statement said officers from within the foreign ministry were being appointed to posts in Paris, Bonn and Canberra.
Sri Lanka said in May it was launching a $2.5 million global public relations campaign to attract investors and tourists by playing down the war.
